# telnyx_email_domain_rotate_dkim (Action)

Creates a new DKIM key for an email domain and signs with it at once. Publish the new DKIM TXT value from `telnyx_email_domain_dns_records` promptly.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain id.
